seriesTitle: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

episodes.title: New World Order
episodes.summary: Sam makes a tough decision while Bucky tries to lead a normal life.

episodes.title: The Star Spangled Man
episodes.summary: All eyes are on the shield, as Sam and Bucky decide to team up — or rather, work together — when a new global threat launches them into an unexpected mission that may hit too close to home. As the world meets its new Captain America, Sam and Bucky try to find a lead on the shadowy Flag Smashers.

episodes.title: Power Broker
episodes.summary: To find the source of the Super Soldier Serum, Sam and Bucky must scale a ladder of low-lifes starting in Madripoor with Zemo.

episodes.title: The Whole World Is Watching
episodes.summary: Sam, Bucky, and Zemo get closer to the Flag Smashers, while both Karli Morgenthau and John Walker make choices they can't undo.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.summary: Sam, Bucky, Zemo, John Walker, and Karli Morgenthau must all deal with the fall out from their actions.

episodes.title: One World, One People
episodes.summary: Sam and Bucky head to New York City for the Global Repatriation Council vote after receiving a tip from Joaquin Torres who tracked activity on the Flag Smasher app in the city. They are going to need some help to take down Karli Morgenthau, who has been radicalized beyond salvation.
